cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.32% · WTI -5.57% · Brent -0.63% · NatGas -2.09%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.26%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.26%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.69%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +10.45%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +10.45%, SEDG +4.35%, ENPH +4.28%, ARRY +3.53%, WFRD +2.63%. Laggards: EOSE -4.97%, PWR -2.89%, ETN -1.92%, GEV -1.47%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
